title: Suzanne B NDE 239
content: I had a car accident and was pronounced 'dead'. I remember feeling comfortable. I also remember the fact that I was 'coming back' and that I had certain obligations towards myself. I had to clean up my act, so to speak. I was experimenting with alcohol and cigarettes. I knew that I had to stop taking these substances into my body as it affected the connection that I had with the universe. I had always been 'aware' of things that most people weren't. When I was a child an older lady would 'come and get me' and show me things. I saw 'televisions with pictures that could be controlled by an operator' -- I know these to be computers now. I met with 'beings' that looked a lot like the drawings that I have seen of 'aliens'. I have had an uncanny sense of the 'departed' and can sum up a person within minutes of meeting with them. I can sense their pain and fear levels. I can unravel their minds for them, in a short conversation. These skills became 'more' after my experience. The future, so to speak, was shown to me. I saw faces of people that would be instrumental in my life, but that I had not met yet. My life now, seems to be some sort of slow motion replay of the events of that afternoon in 1983.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Clinical death I had a car accident and was pronounced 'dead'. The medics were about to 'body bag' me when I sat bolt upright and screamed.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Special Knowledge | Vision of the future
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I looked like me, but because of my prior experience with the astral, knew that I had separated from my body.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Within my soul, I was conscious. My body was 'unconscious'.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning As one does when they enter the astral. No time, no space. Oneness.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes The old lady was there, as were two 'alien' beings. The communication was full, but quick. I would need a book to explain it. It is of my understanding that all will be okay. I knew the old lady. She was my guide at the time. The two alien beings are of my soul family, and I communicate with them still.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Light emanated from my being, and those that were there with me.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I recognized the place as the place I would go to, when I entered the astral with the older lady guide.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Safe and comfortable. Like I had come home, again.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe The key to knowing is learning to know oneself.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes A clarification of my gift, and the effect I was to have on the lives of those I came in contact with in the future.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes A clarification of my gift, and the effect I was to have on the lives of those I came in contact with in the future. After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: No I had these gifts prior to my experience.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best part was the comfort and love that I felt. The worst was the weeks afterwards when my body recovered from the shock. My body took a shaking up to be honest, and it took it a while to recover.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Most people think I am full of it. Only recently, say in the last eight to ten years, have people began to understand the universal oneness connection that we all share. I am glad that there has been a lessening of judgment of those like myself.
